description: Values in evidence/ledger.json that come from public data sets and can drift: browser support from mdn/browser-compat-data and Fyrd/caniuse, and licence fields from the npm registry. scripts/freshness.mjs reads only these data files, never a web page, and compares them with the snapshots below, which state what the ledger entry says. A difference opens an issue; nobody re-measures or edits the ledger automatically.
